name: Tōkai (Ibaraki, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tōkai village emblem in green: a ring beneath a stylised device of curved leaf-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Tōkai, a village in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 28 February 1995; the emblem dates from 1 April 1963.

features.role: Tōkai village emblem — a ring beneath a stylised device of curved leaf-like strokes
